title: ArcBio Continuous DNA Workflow - Pre-PCR Library Purification Indexing
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Add Tris to samples
steps.instruction: Add Tris buffer to each sample while the plate is positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Perform bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Carry out bead‑based purification on the samples.

steps.title: Combine index pair
steps.instruction: Combine the index pair with the eluted sample and incubate at 4 °C on the temperature module.

steps.title: Add enzyme 16
steps.instruction: Add enzyme 16 to the reaction mixture.
